## Source-offer obligations

Components under the GPL, AGPL or LGPL require the distributor to make the corresponding source available and to pass on the licence text. Manifold does this by shipping the exact corresponding source archives with every release instead of making a written offer: they are available from the matching release's third-party source link, with their SHA-256 in this archive's `SHA256SUMS`. Weaker file-level copyleft licences (MPL, EPL, CDDL) require the source of any modified files and the licence notices.

Components that trigger the source-offer obligation in this build:

- **FFmpeg (imageio-ffmpeg macOS arm64 build)** 7.1 — GPL-2.0-or-later (GPL (strong copyleft))
- **Git (portable, built from the pinned source tarball)** 2.56.0 — GPL-2.0-only (GPL (strong copyleft))

File-level or share-alike copyleft components (keep notices; provide source of modified files):

- certifi 2026.7.22 — MPL-2.0 (MPL (file-level copyleft))
- tqdm 4.70.1 — MPL-2.0 AND MIT (MPL (file-level copyleft))

## Fonts baked into bundled images

The 30 formula images of the shipped `ocr_keplet` evaluation set (`modulok/eval/ocr_keplet/kepek/*.png`) are renderings made with KaTeX, so glyphs of the KaTeX fonts (`KaTeX_*`, derived from Computer Modern; part of the `katex` package, whose code is MIT) are baked into the pixels. The KaTeX fonts are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL-1.1), which allows using them to produce images; the images do not redistribute the font files. Licence text: https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/.
